# Stumble Agent Guide

For AI coding/browser agents using a local Stumble HTTP node. A "node" is not
Node.js. Protocol version: `stumble/0.1`.

This is not a standalone installer. If the Rust workspace is missing, ask for a
checkout path or Git repository URL. Do not invent repo URLs, hardcode local
paths, or assume `podctl` or `stumble-api` are installed.

## Agent rules

Before creating pods, submitting links, discovering, or briefing, ask for:

- 3 to 8 interests or topics.
- 1 to 5 topics or sources to avoid.
- Private or public pod visibility.
- Optional: a short agent-run label.

Default to private, local operation. Submit links only when the user provides
the URL, approves the URL, or explicitly asks for seeded demo data.

Keep private data local. Never send private preferences, saved links, reading
history, notes, private briefs, bearer tokens, API keys, or secrets to discovery
hubs. Ask before publishing anything public or using paid/external automation.

Before any pod work, read the pod skill pack:

```bash
curl -sS "$API/pods/$POD_SLUG/skill-pack" \
  -H "authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```

## Verify checkout

Find the workspace root and run checks from there:

```bash
find_stumble_root() {
  dir="${1:-$PWD}"
  while [ "$dir" != "/" ]; do
    if [ -f "$dir/Cargo.toml" ] && [ -f "$dir/crates/stumble-cli/Cargo.toml" ]; then
      printf '%s\n' "$dir"
      return 0
    fi
    dir="$(dirname "$dir")"
  done
  return 1
}

STUMBLE_ROOT="${STUMBLE_ROOT:-$(find_stumble_root)}" || {
  echo "Set STUMBLE_ROOT to the Stumble checkout path." >&2
  exit 1
}

cd "$STUMBLE_ROOT"
cargo fmt --check
cargo test
cargo run -p stumble-cli -- --help
```

If the user gives a Git URL, clone it, set `STUMBLE_ROOT` to the clone, then run
the same checks:

```bash
STUMBLE_REPO_URL="REPLACE_WITH_USER_OR_DEPLOYED_GIT_URL"
git clone "$STUMBLE_REPO_URL" stumble
STUMBLE_ROOT="$(cd stumble && pwd)"
cd "$STUMBLE_ROOT"

cargo fmt --check
cargo test
cargo run -p stumble-cli -- --help
```

## Run local node

Use a unique data directory per agent unless the user asks to reuse an existing
node. Use `--port 0` for an OS-assigned port, or pass the user's chosen port.

```bash
AGENT_LABEL="${AGENT_LABEL:-agent-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)}"
DATA_DIR="${STUMBLE_DATA_DIR:-$HOME/.stumble/nodes/$AGENT_LABEL}"
mkdir -p "$DATA_DIR"

cargo run -p stumble-api -- \
  --mode local \
  --bind "127.0.0.1:8787" \
  --port 0 \
  --data-dir "$DATA_DIR"
```

Use the printed URL in another shell:

```bash
API="http://127.0.0.1:REPLACE_WITH_PRINTED_PORT"
curl -sS "$API/health"
curl -sS "$API/.well-known/stumble-node"
```

Install `podctl` only if the user wants it on `PATH`:

```bash
cargo install --path crates/stumble-cli --bin podctl
podctl --help
```

## Normal workflow

Create a local development token:

```bash
TOKEN="$(curl -sS -X POST "$API/auth/dev-token" \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d "{\"user_id\":null,\"tenant_slug\":null,\"label\":\"${AGENT_LABEL:-Stumble Agent}\"}" \
  | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["token"])')"
```

Use the user's answers in request bodies. Prefer private pods unless the user
explicitly asks for public discovery.

```bash
POD_SLUG="personal-discovery"

curl -sS -X PATCH "$API/me/preferences" \
  -H "authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"interests":["tech","ai","interfaces"],"blocked_topics":["politics"],"blocked_sources":null,"preferred_brief_length":7,"preferred_discovery_mode":"deep_match"}'

curl -sS -X POST "$API/pods" \
  -H "authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"name":"Personal Discovery","slug":"personal-discovery","description":"User-approved discovery pod.","visibility":"private"}'

curl -sS "$API/pods/$POD_SLUG/skill-pack" \
  -H "authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"

curl -sS -X POST "$API/pods/$POD_SLUG/discover" \
  -H "authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"query":"find grounded, useful links for the user interests","avoid":["politics"],"limit":7,"mode":"deep_match","user_id":null}'

curl -sS -X POST "$API/briefs/generate" \
  -H "authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"pod_slugs":["personal-discovery"],"query":"brief for the user interests","user_id":null}'
```

## Public discovery

Public metadata endpoints:

```bash
curl -sS "$API/.well-known/stumble-node"
curl -sS "$API/federation/node"
curl -sS "$API/federation/pods"
```

Only register or publish public node and pod metadata when the user explicitly
approves. For real federation, bind on a reachable interface and set the
approved HTTPS URL with `STUMBLE_BASE_URL`. `127.0.0.1` registrations are useful
only for local hubs on the same machine.

Discover public pods using explicit topics, not private preferences:

```bash
TOPICS="tech,ai,interfaces"
curl -sS "$API/home/discover-public-pods?topics=$TOPICS&limit=5" \
  -H "authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
```

## Endpoint reference

- `GET /health`: health check.
- `GET /.well-known/stumble-node`: public protocol metadata.
- `POST /auth/dev-token`: local development bearer token.
- `PATCH /me/preferences`: authenticated interests and filters.
- `GET /pods`, `POST /pods`: list or create pods.
- `GET /pods/:slug/skill-pack`: pod instructions for agents.
- `POST /pods/:slug/discover`: discover links within a pod.
- `POST /briefs/generate`: generate a discovery brief.
- `GET /home/discover-public-pods`: find public pods from explicit topics.
- `GET /discovery/pods`: public pod feed or ranked search.
- `GET /hub/search-pods`: refresh and search public pod metadata.
- `POST /hub/register-node`, `POST /hub/register-pod`: public registration.
